Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): wire format and connection plumbing: native messages are structs by design (SPEC: messages are structs, not bytes). Formerly listed as missing: The full-data form (includeInitialize true, the chunk bytes) is never built natively: chunk loads reach the client as S26 bulk entries or through the shared world; only the unload form ('u') is modeled (serverreplay.c:sr_client_chunk).
